messages.subject: Posterior predictive samples
parts:
Hi all,

I hope to obtain several sets of predicted data (y), and I used the "ppSamplerNF" function, which is available here. The model is a simple factor analysis model (see the attached nimble code).

I did get some new data from the "cppSampler$run(samples)," but I am not sure if they are the predicted data I am seeking. 

Thank you very much for your time.


Best,
Chris

Is that what you are looking for?

-chris
